jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Manager
jobs.location: Eden Prairie, MN United States of America
jobs.description:
C.H. Robinson is the global leader in Lean AI supply chains. By bringing together expert people, industry-leading technology, and a disciplined operating model, we take on some of the toughest supply chain challenges and continuously improve how we deliver for our customers.

We’re seeking a Continuous Improvement Manager to help advance organizational excellence across our Finance organization by leveraging the principles of the Robinson Operating Model (ROM). In this role, you will lead strategic initiatives through a disciplined continuous improvement framework, partnering with stakeholders at all levels to remove friction, strengthen operational performance, and create smarter, more efficient ways of working. You’ll bring Lean or Six Sigma expertise, strong change management capabilities, and proven success leading multiple cross-functional initiatives as we raise the bar and keep the world moving forward, every shipment, every challenge, every day.

Responsibilities:
The duties and responsibilities of this position consists of, but are not limited to, the following:
- Identify and remove waste, friction, and frustration from Finance processes, creating mechanisms to proactively assess process effectiveness and efficiency

- Lead Business Process Management strategic initiatives that maximize customer value, increase operational efficiency, and improve volume throughput

- Support implementation of Finance operational strategy and planning in alignment with functional and enterprise priorities

- Partner with Analytics teams to create and improve operational performance reporting that provides leadership and employees with visibility into performance, workload, resources, and improvement opportunities

- Advance process automation and enabling technology by collaborating with technology partners and related resources to simplify work and improve outcomes

- Collaborate with business partners across functions to deploy tools, processes, and resources that support successful project implementation and sustainable change

- Manage relationships and communication across internal and external project resources, stakeholders, and senior leaders to keep initiatives aligned and moving forward

- Build accountability and engagement by motivating project teams, clarifying ownership, and reinforcing a continuous improvement mindset

- Create and deliver ongoing continuous improvement training, coaching, and development to strengthen capability across teams

- Drive an analytical culture that improves decision-making and increases efficiency, quality, profitability, and customer value

Required Qualifications:
- 6+ years of professional experience executing large, cross functional initiatives

- Minimum 3 years of experience using a continuous improvement framework within business operations such as Lean, Six Sigma or similar

- Minimum 3 years of project management experience

- Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university

Preferred Qualifications:
- Certification in Lean, Six Sigma and/or related methodologies

- Experience using business and data analytics to drive continuous improvement

- Strong change management capabilities with emphasis on team behavior change

- Excellent planning and project management skills with strong ability to effectively manage multiple cross-functional projects simultaneously

- Thrive in an ambiguous work environment with minimal supervision and ability to make timely decisions

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging to the appropriate audience

- Demonstrated leadership in a matrix organization, influencing without authority, conflict resolution skills, and ability to motivate and inspire team members to high performance levels

- Values a diverse and inclusive work environment

We will review applications for this role on an ongoing basis and encourage all interested candidates to apply at their earliest convenience.

jobs.title: M&A Integrations Sr Project Manager
jobs.location: Eden Prairie, MN United States of America
jobs.description:
C.H. Robinson is the global leader in Lean AI supply chains. By bringing together expert people, industry-leading technology, and a disciplined operating model, we take on some of the toughest supply chain challenges and continuously improve how we deliver for our customers.

We’re seeking a Senior Project Manager to lead the integration of acquired businesses into our global enterprise. In this highly visible role, you’ll bring structure to complex integrations, aligning teams across the business to turn strategy into action, navigate change, and deliver lasting business value.

You’ll serve as a central point of coordination, building and executing integration plans, anticipating challenges, and continuously improving how we work. Along the way, you’ll partner with experts across the business, take on real responsibility, and help shape how we build what’s next at C.H. Robinson.

At C.H. Robinson, we believe collaboration plays an important role in how we solve complex problems and drive meaningful results. For this role, we have a preference for candidates located near our Eden Prairie, MN, or Chicago, IL offices, where there are opportunities for in-person connection and collaboration. However, we’re open to fully remote candidates and will prioritize finding the right person for the role.

Responsibilities:
The duties and responsibilities of this position consists of, but are not limited to, the following:
- Lead multiple, large-scale, and complex integration projects, translating strategic priorities into actionable plans and driving execution across cross-functional teams

- Own critical project documentation, including project charters, plans, process flows and value stream maps, resource requirements, and business cases

- Bring together internal and external stakeholders around shared priorities, deliverables, dependencies, and decisions, building trust through clear and consistent communication

- Drive projects forward to deliver quality solutions on time and within budget, taking ownership of outcomes, proactively identifying risks, resolving issues, and escalating when appropriate

- Lead teams through change by influencing without direct authority, welcoming different perspectives, and constructively challenging the status quo to achieve stronger outcomes

- Track, manage, and communicate project progress and financial performance, including resource requirements, budget-to-actual performance, key milestones, and project outcomes

- Apply a continuous improvement and builder mindset to identify opportunities, solve complex problems, and strengthen the tools, processes, and ways of working that support successful integrations

- Partner with experts across the business to transfer knowledge, strengthen organizational capabilities, and mentor project team members
- Lead Robinson Operating Model (ROM) projects internally to advance our lean operating model

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university

- Minimum 5 years of project management experience, with the proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

- Ability to work flexible hours (some weekend/late hours may be required)

Preferred Qualifications:
- Project Management Professional certification

- Work and/or project experience in Supply Chain, Transportation, and/or Logistics

- Strong communication skills: strong listener with exceptional facilitation skills and the ability to tell the story and connect to your audience

- Ability to organize, design, develop, and deliver projects for internal and external audiences at all levels

- Ability to collaborate effectively with subject matter experts internally and externally at all levels

- Experience working and thriving in a continuous improvement environment

- Experience and comfort in dealing with ambiguity and able to deliver with minimal oversight

- Experience working directly with customers

- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite of programs

- Experience with lean processes and tools

- Values a diverse and inclusive work environment

jobs.title: Principal Customer Analytics
jobs.location: Eden Prairie, MN United States of America
jobs.description:
C.H Robinson is seeking a Principal Analytics Consultant to lead high-impact, customer-facing analytics. You’ll play a critical part in helping us differentiate through insight; ensuring our commercial teams don’t just have access to data but know how to use it to win. You’ll help shape how analytics shows up in the moments that matter most: customer conversations, strategic trade-offs, and growth decisions. You’ll thrive in this role if you’re a technical problem solver who transforms complex data into clear, actionable insights, communicates those insights through effective storytelling, and builds strong relationships that drive meaningful business decisions.

C.H. Robinson moves the world’s freight. We’re the industry leader in lean AI-powered supply chains that help our customers move with precision, efficiency, and confidence. Our North American Surface Transportation (NAST) Customer-Facing Analytics team turns that advantage into smarter signals, prescriptive insights, and scalable analytics solutions that accelerate customer growth and fuel commercial success.

Responsibilities:
- Translate complex, multi-source data (internal + external) into crisp stories, insights, and recommendations that accelerate customer growth, retention, and wallet share.
- Embed analytics at the front of the sales cycle to raise win rates; integrate insights into QBRs, strategic reviews, and value narratives.
- Build dashboards, indexes, scorecards, and repeatable playbooks that move teams from defensive reporting to offensive engagement.
- Serve as a front-line liaison across customers, account teams, and analytics, translating business questions into analytical solutions and product enhancements.
- Capture the voice of the customer, prioritize enhancements, and contribute to product strategy that reflects market needs and emerging best practices.
- Deliver workshops, demos, and training, and curate “what to use when” libraries, case studies, and best practices.
- Combine internal ops data with industry signals (e.g., DAT, FTR, ACT, Statista) to craft market perspectives and thematic narratives customers can act on.
- Engage with strategic and high-potential customers and participate in industry forums as a C.H. Robinson analytics voice.

Required Qualifications:
- 6+ years in analytics, decision science, consulting, or insights roles.
- 2+ years’ experience delivering insights that influence deals, renewals, or account growth.
- 4+ years’ experience with data modeling concepts, BI practices, and scalability (tools-agnostic; e.g., SQL/PowerBI/Python/modern BI a plus).
- Familiarity with supply chain or transportation data.
- Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Exceptional communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to lead complex initiatives, balance both speed and rigor, and navigate ambiguity.
- Experience with quantitative and qualitative research.
- Values a diverse and inclusive work environment.

jobs.location: Chicago, IL United States of America
jobs.description:
C.H. Robinson is seeking an HR Business Partner Manager to support our Enterprise Strategy & Innovation and Technology, and Robinson Managed Solutions (RMS) teams.  In this individual contributor role you will support business leaders to impact and influence business strategy, people initiatives, and aide our leadership team to be effective in a changing environment. You will leverage people management tools and resources to align with business goals and personal development. You will partner directly with business leadership to understand their business needs, focusing on talent and leadership development, and facilitating alignment of HR initiatives and business strategy through partnership with HR Centers of Expertise. Your ability to navigate “the grey” and drive groups to make timely decisions through effective facilitation and communication skills will set you up for success in this role, as well as your ability to collaborate across groups and influence all levels of the organization.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
The duties and responsibilities of this position consists of, but are not limited to, the following:
- Partner with executive and senior leaders as a trusted advisor to align people strategies with business objectives and drive organizational success
- Influence workforce planning, organizational design, and talent strategies that enable long-term business growth and transformation
- Lead talent management initiatives, including succession planning, talent reviews, calibration sessions, and leadership development programs
- Coach leaders on performance management, employee development, career growth, and organizational effectiveness
- Use workforce analytics, talent metrics, and industry benchmarks to identify opportunities, solve complex challenges, and inform strategic decisions
- Drive change management and communication strategies that support business initiatives, organizational changes, and workforce transitions
- Collaborate with leaders and Centers of Excellence (COEs) to develop and implement solutions that enhance employee engagement, culture, and business performance
- Facilitate leadership assessment and development through feedback processes, talent evaluations, and targeted development planning
- Advise leaders on team effectiveness, performance improvement, and strategic talent decisions to strengthen organizational capability
- Champion an inclusive, high-performing workplace culture by partnering with leaders to advance employee experience and DE&I initiatives

Required:
- Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Human Resources or related degree
- Minimum 6 years of progressive HR experience
- Minimum 2 years' experience working directly with senior and/or executive level leaders
- Minimum 2 years' experience supporting a global business population
- Ability to travel up to 20% (domestically and internationally)

- Previous Human Resource Business Partner experience
- Experience working in the technology industry
- Demonstrated experience consulting, influencing without authority, effectively resolving conflict, and thriving in a fast-paced, decentralized, matrixed, global environment

jobs.description:

In this role you will engage directly with customers to expand business, strengthen retention, and manage escalations across a portfolio of small to midsize shippers. You will also lead and mentor Portfolio Executives and Associate Portfolio Executives, providing guidance and support to accelerate their success. In this role, you will partner closely with your General Manager, internal stakeholders, and external partners to uncover new opportunities and deliver exceptional customer outcomes. This is a high-impact role for a proven leader who thrives in both business development and people development.

At C.H. Robinson, we believe that in-person collaboration is key to driving innovation and achieving success. In this role, you will work on-site with your peers five days a week, fostering creativity and producing impactful results through face-to-face interactions. Experience the full benefits of teamwork and immediate collaboration in a vibrant and engaging workplace.

Responsibilities:

The duties and responsibilities of this position consists of, but are not limited to, the following:

Business Development Focus
- Diagnose opportunities, qualify leads, create deal teams, develop business strategies, and propose solutions to drive growth within their team’s portfolio of accounts.
- Actively enhances customer experience and retention by serving as the primary de-escalation point for active customers with a focus on solving tactical and strategic customer challenges on a daily basis.
- Provide industry insights, market feedback, and competitive intelligence to inform strategic decision-making and enhance customer value.
- Actively works with their GM to monitor their team’s portfolio and review accounts may benefit from account team alignment outside of Brokerage Sales that based on size or complexity.
- Build and maintain trusting relationships with internal and external stakeholders, acting as an ambassador for our Brokerage Sales strategy.

- Lead and develop a team of developing Portfolio Executives and Associate PEs, providing coaching, mentorship, and performance feedback.
- Ultimately accountable to ensure Associate Portfolio Executives graduate to remove the Associate title by maximizing their developed and holding those Associates accountable to meeting or exceeding their tenure expectations.
- Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team.
- Identify and address performance gaps, providing support and resources to help team members achieve their goals.
- Promote diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives to create a positive and inclusive work environment.

Required Qualifications:
- High school diploma or GED equivalent
- Minimum of 5 years of sales or account management or equivalent experience
- Minimum 2 years of experience directly or indirectly leading or managing teams

jobs.title: Director, Marketing (Robinson Managed Solutions)
jobs.description:
C.H. Robinson is currently seeking a Director of Marketing who will lead the business-to-business marketing strategy for the Robinson Managed Solutions (RMS) division, with a strong focus on driving growth through AI solutions, advanced technology platforms, and market-facing product and solution narratives. You will sit at the intersection of technology, product, marketing, communications and enterprise and commercial strategy, translating complex, AI-enabled logistics capabilities into clear, compelling value propositions that drive adoption, revenue growth, and category leadership.

As the Director, you will own marketing strategy for RMS technology solutions and Autonomous Logistics. You will collaborate closely with business and executive leadership, communications and marketing leadership, and channel and brand/creative teams to shape marketing priorities and ensure measurable market clarity, differentiation, and business impact. You will also partner at an enterprise level on solution positioning, and technology storytelling while serving as a strategic advisor to senior stakeholders.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and execute the marketing vision, strategy, and go-to-market plans for C.H. Robinson's Robinson Managed Solutions (RMS) technology products, AI-enabled solutions, automation capabilities, and Autonomous Logistics offerings, ensuring alignment with business growth and revenue objectives
- Translate complex technology, AI, and managed solutions capabilities into compelling value propositions, positioning, messaging, and market narratives that clearly articulate differentiated customer value and drive adoption
- Partner closely with Product, Technology, Commercial, and Sales leaders to align customer needs, product roadmaps, and solution strategies, while strengthening sales enablement, market readiness, and commercial activation
- Lead solution-level storytelling across products, platforms, services, and emerging technologies, ensuring consistent messaging across campaigns, executive communications, thought leadership, brand initiatives, and customer-facing channels
- Serve as a strategic advisor to senior leaders, providing expertise on market trends, competitive dynamics, AI innovation, technology positioning, and growth opportunities to strengthen market differentiation and category leadership
- Establish and monitor key performance indicators, leveraging customer insights, market intelligence, adoption metrics, and business results to optimize marketing effectiveness, prioritize investments, and drive measurable impact
- Foster strong cross-functional collaboration by bridging technical, product, marketing, communications, and commercial teams to align strategy, execution, and business outcomes
- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing marketing organization, building team capability, driving accountability and innovation, and supporting workforce planning, succession development, and organizational growth

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college/university
- Minimum 8 years of experience marketing for a tech company, product marketing or technology marketing
- Minimum 4 years of experience leading and managing teams
- Demonstrated experience translating complex technology or AI-driven solutions into market-facing value propositions that drive growth
- Ability to travel up to 15%

Preferred Qualifications:
- Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, Technology, or a related field

- Exceptional strategic thinking, analytical, and communication skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and non-technical audiences

jobs.title: Manager of Sales Enablement
jobs.location: Chicago, IL United States of America
jobs.description:
C.H. Robinson is looking for a Manager, Sales Enablement, to join our team.  In this role will lead a team of Sales Enablement Managers (SEMs) focused on improving frontline sales execution, seller productivity, manager effectiveness, and pipeline generation quality across the organization. You will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Marketing, Product, and frontline managers to drive scalable selling behaviors and consistent execution across the customer lifecycle. You are accountable for improving top-of-funnel rigor, pipeline creation quality, and early-stage conversion performance across the sales organization.

If you possess a strong understanding of modern B2B sales execution, organizational leadership, seller workflows, and performance improvement within complex commercial environments, you may be a great fit for this position!

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Lead & Develop the Sales Enablement Team
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of Sales Enablement Managers supporting frontline sales teams
- Establish clear priorities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations across the SEM organization
- Build a high-performing enablement culture focused on execution, accountability, continuous improvement, and field partnership
- Develop talent and create scalable approaches that improve consistency across the organization

Top-of-Funnel & Pipeline Creation Accountability
- Own the operating framework for top-of-funnel execution, including outbound workflows, engagement strategy, and qualification standards
- Drive measurable improvement in engagement-to-qualified pipeline and qualified-to-sales-accepted conversion rates
- Improve early-stage pipeline velocity and opportunity quality across the sales organization
- Partner with Sales Leadership to enforce consistent pipeline inspection, qualification rigor, and handoff quality
- Standardize how pipeline is created, qualified, and progressed to ensure consistency and predictability of outcomes

Improve Seller Productivity & Revenue Execution
- Drive measurable improvement in pipeline generation quality, opportunity progression, and seller effectiveness across the sales organization
- Identify operational friction points and simplify workflows, tools, and processes to improve seller productivity and execution speed
- Partner with sales leadership to drive consistency in discovery, qualification, opportunity management, and customer engagement
- Own and drive execution of scalable sales methodologies and frontline commercial disciplines (e.g., MEDDIC, stage criteria, cadence execution)

Operationalize Sales Strategy
- Translate organizational priorities into actionable execution frameworks, workflows, and manager cadences
- Partner cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Marketing, Product, and Sales Leadership to drive alignment and execution consistency
- Leverage KPI trends, conversion metrics, seller feedback, and pipeline insights to identify execution gaps and improvement opportunities
- Drive adoption and enforcement of standardized selling practices and operational standards

Improve Manager Coaching & Accountability
- Improve frontline manager coaching effectiveness, inspection quality, and performance management consistency
- Define and implement leading indicators tied to pipeline creation, conversion, and revenue outcomes
- Reinforce accountability systems that improve execution quality, pipeline discipline, and performance consistency without unnecessary complexity

Advance Modern Enablement Capabilities
- Support the integration of AI-enabled workflows, sales technologies, and customer intelligence capabilities into daily seller execution
- Scale modern enablement practices that improve productivity, personalization, and customer engagement quality
- Continuously evaluate opportunities to improve seller efficiency and execution consistency through process and technology improvements

Success Metrics
- Success in this role is measured through improvements in pipeline creation rates, conversion metrics, early-stage velocity, seller productivity, and execution consistency across the sales organization

QUALIFICATIONS
Required:
- 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales leadership, revenue operations, commercial operations, or related go-to-market functions
- 2+ years of people leadership experience with demonstrated ability to coach and develop high-performing teams
- Experience improving sales execution, pipeline generation, seller productivity, or opportunity management within a B2B sales environment
- Strong understanding of modern sales methodologies, pipeline management, and commercial workflows
- Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders across multiple functions
- Strong communication, facilitation, organizational, and leadership skills
- Analytical mindset with ability to leverage data and field feedback to drive continuous improvement
- Experience driving adoption and behavioral change across sales organizations

Preferred:
- Experience supporting large, distributed sales organizations
- Experience with MEDDIC or similar sales methodologies
- Experience integrating AI-enabled workflows or sales technologies into commercial execution
- Background in logistics, transportation, supply chain, SaaS, or operationally complex industries
- Experience building scalable coaching, onboarding, or manager enablement programs
- Strong understanding of outbound pipeline generation and account-based engagement strategies

C.H. Robinson is looking for a strategic and results-driven Sourcing Manager to help shape and execute our vendor supply strategy. In this role, you will build and manage key vendor partnerships, develop supply plans that meet customer demand, and leverage market insights to drive growth and profitability. You will play a critical role in pricing, procurement, and supplier performance while identifying innovative solutions that strengthen our competitive position. Working across both tactical and strategic initiatives, you will help optimize supply, mitigate risk, and maximize sales opportunities in a dynamic market environment. jobs.title: Compliance Analyst
jobs.location: Long Beach, CA United States of America
jobs.description:
C.H. Robinson is seeking a Compliance Analyst to strengthen our U.S. Customs compliance programs, reduce organizational risk, and support consistent performance across our brokerage network. In this role, you will conduct compliance audits, manage post-entry activities, monitor evolving trade regulations, and turn findings into practical guidance for internal teams and customers. You will also deliver training and partner with stakeholders to resolve compliance issues, maintain accurate records, and develop solutions to complex customs challenges. Apply today to help shape strong, data-driven compliance practices in a fast-moving global environment.

At C.H. Robinson, we’re firm believers in the power of in-person collaboration to fuel innovation and propel success. In this role, you will engage with peers on-site three days a week, igniting creativity and driving impactful results. With the flexibility for remote work two days a week, this role strikes the perfect balance between teamwork and autonomy.

**The internal deadline to apply is Monday, October 12th at 9:00 am CST.

Responsibilities:
The duties and responsibilities of this position consists of, but are not limited to, the following:
- Conduct customs compliance audits and partner with branch teams to maintain strong compliance performance across internal, customer, and regulatory programs
- Manage post-entry activities, including entry cancellations, post-summary corrections, and other customs-related updates
- Support customers with responses to U.S. Customs requests, inquiries, resolutions, and compliance documentation
- Serve as a key point of contact for Customs and Participating Government Agency (PGA) communications
- Advise brokerage teams on responding to customer, regulatory, and government inquiries while ensuring compliance with trade requirements
- Administer continuous bond applications, renewals, invoicing, and related customer documentation
- Maintain client Powers of Attorney and ensure accurate, compliant records management
- Monitor and analyze compliance reports, filters, and Automated Broker Interface (ABI) data to identify and address potential issues
- Oversee Automated Clearinghouse (ACH) statements and support clients participating in Periodic Monthly Statement (PMS) programs
- Deliver compliance training, provide consultative trade guidance, and identify opportunities to support customers with customs and trade policy solutions

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree
- Minimum 2 years of experience in import compliance or customs brokerage

Preferred Qualifications:
- Extensive Knowledge of U.S. Customs entry processes and partner government agency regulations
- Strong communication, prioritization, and multi-tasking skills
- Proven critical-thinking and problem-solving skills to adapt to ever-changing tasks and customer needs
- High level of attention to detail
- Licensed Customs Broker (LCB) or CCS Certified Customs Specialist preferred
- Strong understanding of U.S. import regulations on ocean, road, and air transportation documentation requirements
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel (PivotTables,VLOOKUP), and Outlook

- Ability to learn and adapt quickly to new software and technology platforms
- Ability to work and communicate across the branch network

jobs.description:
C.H. Robinson is seeking Customer Success Managers to support the continued growth and scalability of our Redistribution (Redi) business. This role sits at the intersection of Operations, Sales, Transportation, and Account Management, ensuring solutions are operationally feasible, commercially aligned, and designed to scale.
We are hiring across three distinct focus areas within the supply chain:
- Inbound (IB) Redistribution  – focused on supplier management, inventory health, inbound flow, and inventory risk optimization

- Outbound (OB) Redistribution  – focused on order execution, shipment flow, delivery performance, and outbound margin protection

You will play a critical role in representing the business across all customers, identifying challenges, driving resolutions, and ensuring we deliver consistent service, operational quality, and strong customer outcomes. Unlike traditional roles, you are not assigned to a single customer but instead operate across the broader network to support overall success.

At C.H. Robinson, we’re firm believers in the power of in-person collaboration to fuel innovation and propel success. In this role, you will engage with peers on-site four days a week, igniting creativity and driving impactful results. - Execute inbound, outbound, or transportation strategies depending on assigned scope
